description: This file defines the 'Concept' class in the OpenMRS project, representing medical concepts such as questions or answers within the system. It includes numerous methods for managing names, descriptions, answers, attributes, mappings, and set members, as well as extensive locale-specific handling for internationalization. It serves as a central data model for concepts in the OpenMRS healthcare platform.
external_methods: org.openmrs.api.ConceptService.getConcepts(String, List, boolean, Object, Object, Object, Object, Object, Object, Object)

classes.name: Concept
classes.description: The primary class representing a medical or clinical concept within the OpenMRS system, including properties for localization, attribute management, relation with answers, descriptions, mappings, and concept set membership, as well as methods for handling concept variants like names and descriptions in multiple locales.

methods.name: getAnswers
methods.description: Returns a collection of all answers associated with this concept, including retired answers.

methods.name: setAnswers
methods.description: Sets the collection of answers for this concept.

methods.name: addAnswer
methods.description: Adds a ConceptAnswer to the list of answers for this concept, assigning a sort weight if not provided.

methods.name: removeAnswer
methods.description: Removes a specified ConceptAnswer from this concept's answer list.

methods.name: getName
methods.description: Retrieves the default name for the concept, considering locale preferences and fallbacks.

methods.name: setPreferredName
methods.description: Sets a specific ConceptName as the preferred name within its locale, replacing any existing preferred name.

methods.name: getNames
methods.description: Returns all names for this concept, optionally including voided names.

methods.name: addName
methods.description: Adds a new ConceptName to the concept, managing name type priorities.

methods.name: removeName
methods.description: Removes a specific ConceptName from this concept.

methods.name: getDescription
methods.description: Gets the description in the current or specified locale.

methods.name: getDescription(Locale, boolean)
methods.description: Retrieves the concept description matching locale criteria, with options for exact match.

methods.name: getSynonyms
methods.description: Returns all non-retired synonyms for this concept, optionally filtered by locale.

methods.name: getSynonyms()
methods.description: Returns all non-retired synonyms associated with this concept.

methods.name: getSetMembers
methods.description: Returns the list of concepts that are members of this concept set.

methods.name: addSetMember
methods.description: Adds a concept to this concept's set members, optionally at a specified position.

methods.name: getAllConceptNameLocales
methods.description: Returns the set of all locales in which the concept has names.
